description: This is a Java source file for an Android activity class 'NetworkActivity'. It handles displaying recent StackOverflow questions tagged 'android' within a WebView, manages network connectivity state, and downloads and parses XML feeds asynchronously. It also includes network change broadcast receiver logic and user preferences handling.

classes.name: NetworkActivity
classes.description: Main activity handling UI for displaying StackOverflow questions, network state management, content download, and parsing.

classes.name: NetworkReceiver
classes.description: Inner class BroadcastReceiver monitoring network connectivity changes to update app behavior.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up network broadcast receiver.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Retrieves user preferences, updates network flags, loads page if appropriate.

methods.name: updateConnectedFlags
methods.description: Checks current network state and updates wifiConnected and mobileConnected flags.

methods.name: loadPage
methods.description: Determines whether to initiate download of XML feed based on network and preferences.

methods.name: showErrorPage
methods.description: Displays error message in WebView if network content cannot be loaded.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates options menu for settings and refresh actions.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection for settings and refresh.

methods.name: loadXmlFromNetwork
methods.description: Downloads, parses XML from the network, and builds HTML content.

methods.name: downloadUrl
methods.description: Opens HTTP connection and retrieves InputStream for a given URL.

methods.name: NetworkReceiver.onReceive
methods.description: Updates application refresh flags based on current network connectivity and user preferences.
